title: tc-fan-out-grid
description: A big job fanned out to many workers: one cell per task, live.

tasks.description: Every task in the job, one cell each, in order – its label, state, worker, times, cost, result or error

job.description: What the whole job does – e.g. "Enrich 240 leads"

workers.description: How many workers run at once – used for the time left (defaults to the tasks running now)

now.description: The clock, in epoch ms – without it (and without `elapsed`) the element reads the clock and ticks while tasks run

startedAt.description: When the job started, in epoch ms – defaults to the earliest task start

elapsed.description: The clock as ms from the start of the job; task start/end are then job-relative too. Wins over `now`

selected.description: The id of the task whose window is kept open (null: none). Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

filter.description: The state every other cell steps back from (null: none). Changed by the user unless a tc-filter-change listener calls preventDefault()

label.description: What this task is about, in a few words – e.g. "northwind.io"

start.description: When it started and ended – epoch ms, on the same clock as `now` (or ms from the start of the job with `elapsed`)

attempts.description: How often it was tried – 2 and more show as retries

result.description: What came out, one line – shown in the window of a finished task

error.description: What went wrong – shown in the window of a failed or retrying task
